verdict.rationale: Semgrep's CI integration triggers scans on events like push and pull/merge requests (semgrep-docs-25, semgrep-docs-28), and Managed Scans allows bulk scanning without CI changes (semgrep-docs-15), which provides some automated, repeatable execution. However, there is no explicit evidence of a cron-style or time-based recurring schedule feature — automation is event-triggered rather than scheduled. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron configuration, documentation of recurring interval-based scans, and confirmation that Managed Scans support periodic (not just event-driven) execution.
